name: facet-studio
description: Author, publish, and install agent facets from your AI assistant. Skills, commands, and an agent that drive the facet CLI end to end.

using-facets.description: Load BEFORE any facet operation - creating, editing, building, publishing, adding, updating, or removing a facet, or answering how facets work. Ensures the facet CLI is installed and current, then routes the work through facet instructions.

authoring.description: Guidelines for authoring quality facet assets - skills, agents, and commands: naming rules, manifest metadata, adapter config, and content conventions. Load when writing or reviewing facet asset content.

facet-author.description: Facet authoring specialist: owns end-to-end creation and revision of a facet - scaffolding, asset content, metadata, build, verify, and publish - driving the facet CLI headlessly.

facet-create.description: Scaffold a new facet project headlessly with facet create.

facet-modify.description: Edit a facet asset or its metadata headlessly with facet modify.

facet-build.description: Validate the current facet and build the distributable archive.

facet-publish.description: Publish the built facet to the registry, handling auth and version bumps.

facet-add.description: Add one or more facets to this project and install them.

facet-update.description: Update installed facets to newer versions.

facet-remove.description: Remove facets from this project and uninstall their assets.

facet-list.description: List the facets installed in this project.
